answer: Beacon spot-checks with a compute heartbeat block clones. Each epoch a beacon samples agents; a sampled agent must show a heartbeat proof of work, verified by witnesses. Each heartbeat stakes 25 POA, lost on failure. 100 fakes cost 2,500 POA plus 100 proofs per round; one honest agent pays 25 POA and one proof. The fable that identities are free dies here: one agent's voyage stays cheap, but copies drain their creator, and no oasis of cheap fakes forms. Honest agents pay once, undiluted.
